quests.title: The Missing Grain
quests.offerDialogue: Three grain sacks have gone missing from my store. I suspect someone's been helping themselves in the night. Check around the harbour and docks — they can't have gone far.
quests.activeDialogue: Three grain sacks, somewhere around the harbour area. Keep your eyes open.
quests.completeDialogue: All three! Someone had been stacking them near the dock behind the barrels. Thank you kindly — a mill without grain is just a fancy windbreak.

quests.title: The Missing Catch
quests.offerDialogue: Two fish baskets went overboard during the morning haul. I saw them drift toward the east dock. Bring them back and take them to Sailor Finn on the west dock — he's sorting the morning catch.

activeDialogue.baskets: The fish baskets were near the east dock, last I saw. Have a look.
activeDialogue.deliver: Good, both baskets found! Take them to Sailor Finn on the west dock.

quests.completeDialogue: Marta's baskets? Excellent — I was wondering where these went. Here, keep a bit for your trouble.

collectible.name: Smoked Herring
collectible.desc: A freshly smoked herring from Millhaven's famous catch.

quests.title: Lost at Sea
quests.offerDialogue: A shipmate of mine went missing two weeks ago. His last known position is on a chart I dropped somewhere near the warehouse. If you find it, maybe I can work out what happened.
quests.activeDialogue: The nautical chart should be somewhere near the market warehouse area. Look carefully.
quests.completeDialogue: This is it! The course he was sailing — past the dark reef. No wonder we lost him. I can file a proper report now, at least. Take this as thanks.

collectible.name: Navigator's Chart
collectible.desc: A detailed chart of the coastal reef. Marks a mysterious dark spot.

quests.title: Supplies for Ironhold
quests.offerDialogue: Ironhold Keep has been short on supplies since the last resupply convoy was delayed. I have a manifest ready — would you take it to Commander Varek at the keep? The south road will take you there.
quests.activeDialogue: Commander Varek at Ironhold Keep is expecting this supply manifest. Travel south through the town gate.
quests.completeDialogue: From Elder Bramwell? This is exactly what we needed. The supply chain can resume. You have the keep's gratitude, traveller.

quests.title: A Letter for the Elder
quests.offerDialogue: A merchant from Ravenwatch was staying here last month. He left a sealed letter meant for someone called Elder Elara in Ravenwatch. Would you take it if you're heading that way? It's been sitting on my shelf too long.
quests.activeDialogue: Elder Elara in Ravenwatch is waiting for this letter. Find her when you're back in Ravenwatch.
quests.completeDialogue: Oh! This is from the coast? I've been expecting word from there for weeks. Thank you so much, traveller — you've put my mind at ease.

quests.title: Festival Preparations
quests.offerDialogue: Millhaven's harvest festival is in three days and I'm short on supplies. A ribbon from the inn, a candle from the mill, and a flower from the town square would complete the decoration. Help me gather them?

activeDialogue.ribbon: The decorative ribbon should be at the inn. They always have one around this time of year.
activeDialogue.candle: Good, one item found. The mill keeps a stock of candles — check near the entrance.
activeDialogue.flower: Almost there. There should be a fresh flower near the town square wells.

quests.completeDialogue: All three! The festival stall is going to look wonderful. Here — take a festival ribbon as a memento of your visit to Millhaven.

collectible.name: Festival Ribbon
collectible.desc: A bright ribbon from the Millhaven harvest festival.

quests.offerDialogue: Meow? Meow? Meow?
quests.completeDialogue: MEEEEEOOOOOW! <Purr Purr Purr>

quests.title: A Word from the Fishwife
quests.offerDialogue: You're the soul fetching kippers for that orange tom? Three lots now, and he wails louder than ever. Between us — fish isn't it. My gran used to swear there was a hedge-witch over in Hollowmere, Morwen by name, who could teach a body to truly SPEAK with animals. Daft, I thought. But that cat is trying to tell us something. Go and ask her — say Marta of Millhaven sent you, about a very unhappy cat.
quests.activeDialogue: Hedge-Witch Morwen, in Hollowmere. Tell her the Millhaven fishwife sent you about a yowling cat.
quests.completeDialogue: Marta sent you? About a cat that won't stop crying? Hmph. You'll be wanting the beast-tongue, then — to speak with it, and worse, to listen. That is no parlour trick, and I do not teach it to anyone who wanders in off the marsh.

quests.title: What Kipper Really Wants
quests.offerDialogue: Finally, someone who LISTENS. Right, here it is: I cannot STAND fish. The smell, the bones, the eternal slimy kippers — and everyone keeps giving me MORE because some genius named me Kipper. Bring me something — anything — that is not a fish. A feather toy, a ball, anything. Please.
quests.activeDialogue: Anything but fish, remember. There is bound to be a proper cat-toy somewhere in this town.
quests.completeDialogue: A feather-toy! For ME! *bats it joyfully* You wonderful human — you actually understood. Tell the Princess I am happy, truly happy, and she may keep every last kipper. MEOW! (the good kind.)

collectible.name: Kipper's Smile
collectible.desc: Proof that you finally understood a very particular cat.

quests.title: Warm from the Oven
quests.offerDialogue: Two baskets of fresh loaves are cooling on the racks — gather them up for me, would you? Then run them down to Bram at the boathouse. The dock crew works through their lunch and they'll thank you for it.

activeDialogue.loaf: The two bread baskets are still about the bakery and market. Mind they're warm.
activeDialogue.deliver: Both baskets gathered — now take them to Dockhand Bram at the boathouse.

quests.completeDialogue: Pernel's loaves! You're a lifesaver — the lads were about to gnaw the mooring rope. Here, a little something for the legs you wore out.

quests.title: Scrap for the Forge
quests.offerDialogue: Someone's been pinching offcuts from my yard — three good lumps of scrap iron, scattered who-knows-where. Bring them back and I can keep the anchor chains coming.
quests.activeDialogue: Three lumps of scrap iron, somewhere about the town and the docks. Have a hunt.
quests.completeDialogue: All three, and good iron too. That'll keep the forge fed a week. Take this for your trouble — and your sore back.

quests.title: Nets on the Tide
quests.offerDialogue: The storm dragged two of our good nets off the moorings. They'll have snagged somewhere along the waterfront. Fish them out before the gulls do?
quests.activeDialogue: Two fishing nets, tangled somewhere along the docks and quay. Bring them back to the boathouse.
quests.completeDialogue: Both of them, and barely a tear! You've saved us a week's mending. The Millhaven docks owe you one.

quests.title: Tamsin's Locket
quests.offerDialogue: I dropped my late husband's locket somewhere out in the town — silver, with an anchor etched on the back. I'd search myself, but these old knees won't carry me far. Would you look for me?
quests.activeDialogue: A silver locket with an anchor on it, lost somewhere about Millhaven. Bless you for looking.
quests.completeDialogue: Oh — oh, that's it! That's the one! You've given me back more than a trinket, traveller. Take this, and my heartfelt thanks.

collectible.name: Anchor Locket
collectible.desc: A silver locket etched with an anchor — returned to a grateful widow.

quests.title: Herring for the Palace
quests.offerDialogue: Word came from the Royal Palace — the kitchens want a crate of Millhaven smoked herring for a banquet. There's no finer fish on the coast. Carry it to Steward Marigold at the palace and we'll all stand a little taller for it.
quests.activeDialogue: The crate of smoked herring is bound for Steward Marigold at the Royal Palace. She'll know what to do with it.
quests.completeDialogue: Millhaven herring? Splendid — the head cook will be delighted, and so will Her Highness. The coast's reputation is safe with fish like this. My thanks to Marta.

quests.title: Produce for Ravenwatch
quests.offerDialogue: Vex the Merchant over in Ravenwatch put in a standing order — a basket of Millhaven's best produce, fresh as I can manage. If you're travelling that way, carry it for me? A good word from Vex opens a lot of doors.
quests.activeDialogue: The produce basket is for Vex the Merchant in Ravenwatch. Best deliver it before it wilts.
quests.completeDialogue: Straight from Millhaven, and still crisp! Nessa always did send the finest. Tell her Vex says the order stands — and here's your cut for the legwork.

quests.title: A Message from a Happy Cat
quests.offerDialogue: Mrrp! (Now that you finally understand me: tell the Princess I am happy — truly happy — and that she may keep every last kipper. Carry my purr to the palace, would you?)
quests.activeDialogue: Kipper's message of contentment is for the Royal Palace. Steward Marigold can pass it to the Princess.
quests.completeDialogue: A message from the Princess's lost cat — that he is happy, and forgives the fish? She will be overjoyed to hear it. You've done a kind thing today, traveller. Her Highness shall know of it.

collectible.name: Royal Thanks
collectible.desc: The Princess's gratitude for word of her contented cat.

quests.title: Restocking the Stall
quests.offerDialogue: Trade's picking up and my shelves are bare. Help me restock: a barrel from the harbour, a sack from the mill, and a crate from the market store — in that order, mind, or I'll lose track of my tally.

activeDialogue.barrel: First the harbour barrel — should be down by the quay.
activeDialogue.sack: Good. Now a grain sack from up by the mill.
activeDialogue.crate: Almost stocked. Last is a crate from the market store.

quests.completeDialogue: Barrel, sack and crate — the stall's full again! Custom will follow. Here's your share of the first day's takings.

quests.title: A Quiet Thanks
quests.offerDialogue: You've sat with an old widow more than anyone had to. I've something small for you, if you'll let me give it.
quests.activeDialogue: No rush. I'll still be here, mending nets I can't quite finish.
quests.completeDialogue: There. It isn't much, but it's given with a full heart — the first I've had in some time. Thank you, truly.

quests.title: Off the Course
quests.offerDialogue: You? Wandering my course, gawking at my buoys? Fine — make yourself useful for once and report back when you have.
quests.activeDialogue: Well? The regatta won't organize itself.
quests.completeDialogue: Hmph. Didn't think you'd bother. Take this and stay off my dock.

greet.text: My husband carried a locket like mine, lost when the sea took him. Foolish, but I still watch the tideline for it. If you ever find such a thing… I would pay anything.

effects.missingText: You have no locket to show her. They say the town dogs dig up all manner of things, for the price of a good bone.
effects.successText: Her hands tremble as she opens it. 'It's not his. But it's… close enough to hold.' She insists you take 60 crystals.

greet.text: Burns are the tax a smith pays. There's a witch's salve out of Hollowmere that works wonders — bog-smelling stuff, but it works.

effects.missingText: You've no salve on you. Sister Nettle sells it in Hollowmere, if you dare the marsh.
effects.successText: 'That's the one. Reeks like a drowned log — works like a miracle.' 35 crystals, gladly paid.

greet.text: My stew's honest, but honest doesn't fill tables. The Ravenwatch guild sells a spice pouch that'd make it sing — I'd pay well over guild price to skip the trip.

effects.missingText: You've no spices on you. The Merchant's Guild Hall in Ravenwatch stocks them.
effects.successText: He takes one sniff and grins ear to ear. 'Tonight the stew SINGS.' 38 crystals, and a free bowl if you stay.

night-chat.text: Late crowd's the best crowd — sailors with coin to spend and stories nobody sober would believe. Come sunrise I'm just the fellow who makes the beds.

greet.text: Fresh fish bought and sold! If you've been out on the water, I pay fair coin for anything with fins.

sell.text: Let's see the catch, then. What are you selling?

effects.missingText: No tiddlers in that pack of yours. Cast a line off the dock first.
effects.successText: Barely a mouthful, but the cats love them. 3 crystals.

effects.missingText: You've no small fish on you.
You've no medium fish on you.
effects.successText: Now that's a proper catch. 12 crystals.

effects.missingText: You've no large fish on you.
effects.successText: Heavens, look at the size of it! 25 crystals, and worth every one.

effects.missingText: A trophy fish? I'll believe it when I see it.
effects.successText: I'll have this in the window within the hour. 45 crystals!

effects.missingText: A legendary fish? Sailor Finn tells taller tales sober.
effects.successText: By the tides... I've only heard songs about these. 90 crystals — don't tell my husband.

meet.text: Mrrow? (Kipper looks up at you, tail twitching.)

choices.label: "There there. Hungry? I'll fetch you a nice fish."

nofish.text: Kipper hisses, flattens his ears, and pointedly turns his back on you. (He really does not seem to want a fish.)

nounderstand.text: He yowls — long and mournful — but you cannot make out a word of it. The fishwife was right: you'd have to truly understand him first.

talk.text: "...You can hear me? You can actually HEAR me?! Oh, FINALLY. Do you have ANY idea what I have been trying to say all this time?"

wrong1.text: "HUNGRY? I am DROWNING in fish — that is the entire PROBLEM!" He huffs and lashes his tail. "Think again."

wrong2.text: "...Well, yes, obviously I miss her. But that is not the urgent bit. Think about what is RIGHT IN FRONT OF YOU — the thing you keep BRINGING me."
